'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
*****[[Pakistan]] reportedly shares a revised proposal with the United States from [[Iran]] aimed at ending the war. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/revised-iranian-proposal-end-war-shared-with-us-pakistani-source-says-2026-05-18/ (Reuters)]
*****[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign ministry]] [[Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran|spokesperson]] [[Esmail Baghaei|Esmaeil Baghaei]] says that talks between Iran and the U.S. are still ongoing via [[Pakistan]]i mediation. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-says-talks-with-us-continue-through-pakistani-mediation/3940804 (AA)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Iran]]'s [[Persian Gulf Strait Authority]] announces that any passage through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] that is not coordinated with it and the [[Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran|Iranian armed forces]] is "illegal". [https://aje.news/xex3gi?update=4582720 (Al Jazeera)]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that he has called off planned military strikes against [[Iran]] for tomorrow at the request of [[Middle East]] allies including [[Qatar]]i [[Emir of Qatar|emir]] [[Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani]], [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] [[Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia|crown prince]] [[Mohammed bin Salman]], and [[United Arab Emirates|Emirati]] [[President of the United Arab Emirates|president]] [[Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan]], citing "serious negotiations" taking place. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-says-hes-called-off-iran-strike-planned-for-tuesday-at-request-of-gulf-allies (PBS)] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/trump-says-gulf-leaders-asked-him-hold-resuming-iran-war (Middle East Eye)]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
****[[Hezbollah]] states that it shot down an [[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|military]] aircraft over [[Ayta al-Jabal]] in [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://aje.news/xex3gi?update=4583021 (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] [[Ministry of Public Health (Lebanon)|health ministry]] announces that the death toll has surpassed 3,000 people, with at least 3,020 people killed and 9,273 wounded since the war began on March 2. [https://aje.news/xex3gi?update=4582930 (Al Jazeera)]

***[[Sudanese Armed Forces]] breaks the [[Battle of Dilling|siege]] in [[Dilling, South Kordofan|Dilling]], [[South Kordofan]], for a third time. [https://sudantribune.com/article/314123 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
**[[War crimes during the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)| War crimes during the Sudanese civil war]]
***It is reported that [[Rapid Support Forces]] has released commander [[Abu Lulu]] after previously being arrested last year after videos were seen of him executing and [[El Fasher massacre|massacring]] civilians in [[El Fasher]], [[Sudan]]. He is back in combat following his release.  [https://www.reuters.com/investigations/commander-who-was-filmed-killing-civilians-sudan-is-back-combat-sources-say-2026-05-18/ (Reuters)]
